question: Which of the following ministries introduced the Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Amendment Bill, 2024, in the parliament?

options.text: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Amendment Bill, 2024, was introduced by the **Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas** in the Parliament.
 
• This amendment aims to modernize the existing Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Act, 1948, **to align with current industry practices and challenges**.
 
• The Bill seeks to enhance **efficiency in oilfield operations** and ensure better regulation of exploration and production activities.
 
• It also aims to facilitate **foreign and domestic investment** in India's oil and gas sector while ensuring environmental safeguards.
 
• The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas is responsible for the development and regulation of **petroleum, natural gas, and related industries** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oilfields (Regulation and Development) Act, 1948**

 
 
• The original Act was enacted to regulate the exploration and development of oilfields in India.
 
• It provides the framework for granting licenses and leases for petroleum and natural gas exploration.
 
• The Act ensures that oilfield operations are conducted in a manner that safeguards **national interests and environmental standards**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas**
 
 
• The Ministry oversees the exploration, production, distribution, and pricing of petroleum and natural gas in India.
 
• It also regulates the downstream sector, including refining and marketing of petroleum products.
 
• The Ministry plays a key role in ensuring India’s **energy security** and reducing dependency on imports.
 
 
 
• **India's Oil and Gas Sector**
 
 
• India is the third-largest consumer of crude oil and natural gas globally.
 
• The government has launched initiatives like the Hydrocarbon Exploration and Licensing Policy (HELP) to boost exploration activities.
 
• The sector contributes significantly to India’s GDP and supports industrial growth.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Safeguards in Oilfield Operations**
 
 
• Regulations mandate the use of advanced technology to minimize environmental impact.
 
• Operators are required to adhere to stringent norms for waste management, air quality, and water resource protection.
 
• Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) are mandatory for new oilfield projects.
